answer_format: End your reply with a final line that contains \boxed{<answer>}.

rules.strict: content of the last complete \boxed{...} in the output, braces matched (nesting counted, a backslash-escaped brace literal), boxes ordered by their opening; an unclosed \boxed{ is not a box; the position of the box in the output is not constrained; content via normalize_answer; None without a box or when the content does not normalise
rules.lenient: the GSM8K lenient rule by answer type: the last answer-type token anywhere in the output, via normalize_answer; None without a token

lenient_tokens.words: either word of the task's pair, any case, not glued to a word character: (?<!\w)(?:<w1>|<w2>)(?!\w), IGNORECASE

normalize_answer.letter:
fullmatch \((?P

[A-Z])\)|(?P[A-Z])\)? after one final '.' is dropped; canonical '(X)'
normalize_answer.words: casefold equality with a word of the task's pair after one final '.' is dropped; canonical spelling of the pair
